scenes.text: This tutorial covers PyPI and GitHub. Learn where spaCR releases, source code, installers, issues, and the nightly branch live.
Open PyPI and GitHub from the spaCR section. Use PyPI for the current Python package and GitHub for source code, releases, and issue tracking.
In the main configuration area, compare the stable packaged release with the nightly development branch and choose the one appropriate for your work.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Open the release notes before installing so that version and platform requirements are clear.
When the workflow finishes, you will know where to install spaCR, inspect changes, and report a reproducible problem.
